a.lede: US cybersecurity company F5 warned customers to patch five critical BIG-IP vulnerabilities that attackers can exploit to trigger denial-of-service (DoS) or gain remote code execution. [...]
a.title: F5 releases emergency patches for critical BIG-IP RCE flaws

b.lede: Ransomware attacks often involve credential theft, lateral movement, and attempts to disable security controls long before encryption begins. Acronis examines five warning signs that can help defenders detect intrusions earlier, contain malicious activity, and protect critical systems and backups. [...]
b.title: Five warning signs of ransomware breach before encryption or data theft
